create_blip_text_config: create a BlipTextConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers values
create_blip_vision_config: create a BlipVisionConfig instance with custom image_size, patch_size, and num_attention_heads values
create_blip_config: create a BlipConfig instance with custom projection_dim, logit_scale_init_value, and image_text_hidden_size values
build_blip_config_from_subconfigs: build a BlipConfig by passing separate BlipTextConfig and BlipVisionConfig sub-configurations
initialize_blip_config_from_dicts: initialize a BlipConfig by passing text_config and vision_config as dictionaries
